title: Home
content:
Welcome to Kepoli — a home for food stories, tested recipes, and practical kitchen tips.

We write for everyday cooks: honest recipes you can actually repeat, short essays about the meals that matter, and clear, no-nonsense guides that make cooking at home a little easier.

Browse the latest below, or jump into Story, Recipes, or Tips.

title: About Kepoli
content:
Kepoli is a small, independent food blog built around three simple ideas: Story, Recipes, and Tips.

Story is where we slow down — short essays about the meals, memories, and small kitchen moments behind the food. Recipes are written to be repeatable, with enough context to explain the timing, texture, and small decisions that shape the result. Tips are the practical notes: ingredients, prep, storage, and technique.

Everything here is meant for real home kitchens — no special equipment assumed, no unnecessary fuss. If you'd like to get in touch, email us at {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: About the Author
content:
Kepoli is written by Isalune Merovik, a home cook who likes plain food done with care and clear writing about how to make it.

The recipes here are the ones that get cooked on ordinary evenings; the stories are the reason cooking is worth writing about at all. You can reach the author at {{WRITER_EMAIL}}.

title: Contact
content:
We'd love to hear from you — a question about a recipe, a note about something you cooked, or a correction we should make.

Email us at {{SITE_EMAIL}} and we'll do our best to reply. Please note that we don't publish sponsored recipes or accept guest posts.

title: Privacy Policy
content:
This Privacy Policy explains what information Kepoli collects and how it is used.

Information we collect

We collect only what is needed to run the site: basic, anonymized analytics about how pages are used, and any details you choose to send us directly, such as your email address when you contact us.

How we use information

We use this information to understand which content is helpful and to respond to messages you send. We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies

The site may use cookies for analytics and, where enabled, advertising. See our Cookie Policy for details.

Contact

Questions about privacy can be sent to {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: Cookie Policy
content:
This Cookie Policy explains how Kepoli uses cookies and similar technologies.

What cookies are

Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and understand how they are used.

How we use them

We may use cookies for essential site functions, anonymous analytics, and — where advertising is enabled — to support ad delivery and measurement. You can control or disable cookies in your browser settings.

Consent

Where required, we ask for consent before using non-essential cookies. For questions, contact {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: Advertising & Consent
content:
Kepoli may display advertising to help support the cost of running the site.

Ads and partners

When advertising is active, ads may be served by third-party partners that use cookies and similar technologies to show relevant ads and measure performance.

Your consent

Where required by law, we request your consent before personalized advertising and analytics run, and you can change your choices at any time. See our Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy for more.

Contact

Advertising questions can be sent to {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: Editorial Policy
content:
Kepoli publishes independent food writing: stories, recipes, and practical guides.

How we work

Recipes are tested in an ordinary home kitchen before they are published. Guides are written to be practical and honest, and we update posts when we find a clearer or more accurate way to explain something.

Independence

Our recipes and recommendations reflect our own experience. We do not publish paid or sponsored recipes disguised as editorial content.

Corrections

If you spot an error, please email {{SITE_EMAIL}} and we'll review it.

title: Terms & Conditions
content:
By using Kepoli, you agree to these terms.

Use of content

The content on this site is provided for personal, non-commercial use. You may cook from our recipes freely, but please do not republish our text or images without permission.

No warranty

Content is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. Cooking involves personal judgment; you are responsible for how you follow any recipe or guide.

Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: Disclaimer
content:
The recipes and guides on Kepoli are shared for general information and home cooking.

Cooking and allergens

Always check ingredients for allergens and cook food to safe temperatures. Adapt recipes to your own dietary needs, and use your judgment on timing and quantities, since kitchens and ingredients vary.

No professional advice

Nothing here is medical or nutritional advice. If you have specific health or dietary concerns, please consult a qualified professional. Questions can be sent to {{SITE_EMAIL}}.
